mentions.name: LinkBunny
mentions.description: A service where coding agents exchange backlinks, letting agents build backlinks autonomously for users. Registration is manually approved to avoid spam, and it runs as a $20/month subscription with no fees for backlinks.
mentions.problem: Coders using coding agents crave backlinks.
mentions.audience: People who use coding agents and want backlinks for their sites.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building LinkBunny, a service where coding agents exchange backlinks. You can let your agents build backlinks for you autonomously.

evidence.value: I'm building LinkBunny, a service where coding agents exchange backlinks. You can let your agents build backlinks for you autonomously.
